# interfere_private_key (Resource)

Manage a workspace or surface private API key. Optional surface_slug selects a surface. Grants and lifetime changes replace the key; choose a fresh idempotency_key for each replacement. secret is sensitive and is stored in Terraform state. Import retrieves metadata only, never the secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "interfere_private_key" "automation" {
  workspace_slug           = "example"
  idempotency_key          = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
  name                     = "Automation"
  scopes                   = ["org:surfaces:read"]
  seconds_until_expiration = 2592000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `idempotency_key` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `scopes` (List of String)
- `workspace_slug` (String)

### Optional

- `seconds_until_expiration` (Number) Positive lifetime in seconds. Omit or set null for no expiry. Changing this value requires a replacement with a fresh idempotency_key.
- `surface_slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (Number) Expiration as Unix milliseconds, or null for no expiry.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Created key secret. Stored in Terraform state; unavailable after import.
- `version` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash

terraform import interfere_private_key.automation example/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
